text: The system shall ingest candidate resumes, cover letters, and application form responses for recruitment screening.
The system shall generate a suitability score for each candidate based on job requirements, experience, education, and skills.
The system shall rank candidates for recruiter review using the generated suitability score.
The system shall explain the main factors that influenced each candidate suitability score in language understandable to a recruiter.
The system shall allow a human recruiter to review, override, or reject any automated ranking before a candidate is removed from consideration.
The system must log every model-generated score, ranking, explanation, recruiter override, and final screening decision.
The system must validate training and evaluation datasets for missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent labels, and demographic performance differences before model training.
The system must not use protected attributes such as race, religion, disability, political opinion, biometric identification, or emotion recognition as ranking inputs.
The system must monitor model accuracy, bias metrics, and data quality checks after deployment and alert administrators when configured thresholds are breached.
